headline: Nigeria Seeks Senate Approval for $7.7 Billion External Loan
summary: Nigerian President Bola Tinubu asked the Senate to approve $7.707 billion in external loans to fund projects outlined in the 2026 budget.
why: External sovereign borrowing by Nigeria impacts its national debt profile, foreign reserves management, and fiscal deficit financing.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Sovereign external borrowing increases national debt obligations to fund budgetary capital projects.
